<!-- generated by packaging/cli_reference.py from `netpulse stop --help`; do not edit -->

```text
netpulse stop [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--timeout <TIMEOUT>` | Seconds to wait for the last flows to be analysed [default: 30] |
| `--force` | Terminate the monitor if it does not stop in time |

Also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options) `--config <FILE>` and `--json`.
